name: PostgreSQL Server
description: Installs PostgreSQL (18 by default) via the PGDG repository, persists data via a named volume, and starts the server on container start through the shared services dispatcher.

version.description: PostgreSQL major version. PGDG packages 15–18 in parallel.

rootPassword.description: Password for the `postgres` superuser (used for both md5 host auth and local password auth).

createDatabase.description: Optional initial database to create on first boot.

createUser.description: Optional initial role to create (with CREATEDB + LOGIN).
